With most other search systems, you will need to create a bunch of shards and It will be expensive to operate the search indexes. But with TurboBuffer, each publication is simply a namespace. Idle namespaces live in object storage which has no compute cost. Active ones are pulled into NVMe and memory caching tiers so they are served very fast.
